question: Does the off-center MACS1931 Lenstool halo align with a wider-field baryonic galaxy concentration that is absent from the current 300 kpc member catalog and 120 arcsec HST/X-ray maps?
selection_boundary: MACS1931 was selected because it is the only one of seven modeled halo components whose capacity-relaxed dominant baryonic origin remains about 499 kpc from the posterior median halo center.
The rectangular sky window, returned columns, and no-prefilter rule are frozen before the full catalog is downloaded or spatially inspected.
All Tractor morphological types are retained so foreground-star contamination is measured rather than hidden by acquisition filtering.
Photometric-redshift fields are obtained by a left join; objects without a photo-z remain in the raw catalog.
This acquisition cannot authorize a gravity result. Membership, background controls, and a forward test require a later frozen analysis protocol.
catalog_query: SELECT L.ls_id,L.ra,L.dec,L.type,L.flux_g,L.flux_r,L.flux_i,L.flux_z,L.flux_ivar_g,L.flux_ivar_r,L.flux_ivar_i,L.flux_ivar_z,L.mw_transmission_g,L.mw_transmission_r,L.mw_transmission_i,L.mw_transmission_z,L.maskbits,L.fitbits,L.shape_r,L.shape_e1,L.shape_e2,L.ref_cat,L.gaia_phot_g_mean_mag,P.z_phot_mean,P.z_phot_median,P.z_phot_std,P.z_phot_l68,P.z_phot_u68,P.z_phot_l95,P.z_phot_u95,P.z_phot_mean_i,P.z_phot_median_i,P.z_phot_std_i,P.z_phot_l68_i,P.z_phot_u68_i,P.z_phot_l95_i,P.z_phot_u95_i,P.z_spec,P.survey FROM ls_dr10.tractor_s AS L LEFT OUTER JOIN ls_dr10.photo_z AS P ON L.ls_id=P.ls_id WHERE L.ra BETWEEN 292.789 AND 293.125 AND L.dec BETWEEN -26.7257 AND -26.4256

cutout.failure_policy: Record an unavailable preview in provenance and continue; the catalog is the required analysis input. The endpoint returned HTTP 503 on 2026-08-01 despite bounded retries.
